whatThisRecordIs: A statement that the standing external counsel adoption reaches the Georgia superior-court pleading family after its rendered evidence was regenerated, and that the regeneration changed measurement and nothing else. It is not a new legal review, it is not a new adoption, and it records no counsel act that did not happen.

derivesFrom.standingAdoptionClause: continuityPolicy.doesNotRequireNewAdoptionFor — "a PDF hash change from pagination or appearance correction"

historicalAdoptionPreserved.note: The historical adoption stays pinned to the bytes counsel read on 2026-08-04. Nothing in it is edited. This record sits beside it and says which later bytes the standing adoption reaches.
historicalAdoptionPreserved.rePinnedNote: ADOPT-01 is a derived record: its hash-bound scope is recomputed from the artifacts on disk, so it cannot be both frozen and verifiable. Re-pinning it moves the measurement and nothing else — adoptedOn, approvedByRole, approvalBasis and the nine approvedRouteIds are byte-identical before and after, and the pre-repin digest of the whole record is kept here so the state counsel read on 2026-08-04 stays recoverable.

causedBy.change: The shared custom-pleading engine now lays VERIFICATION and CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE out with the content they introduce, so neither can stand alone at the foot of a page.

alsoRePinned.what: the six moved packet digests only; page counts, file names and track ids unchanged
the derived hash-bound scope; adoption date, approving role, approval basis and all fourteen approved route ids unchanged

whatDidNotMove.extractedText: identical — every rendered page of every Georgia template compared before and after by extracting the text operators from the content streams
whatDidNotMove.evidence: scripts/rcap-captain-custom-pleading-impact-sweep.mjs, run before and after commit 6b5a521 and compared with --compare
whatDidNotMove.pageCount: identical on all nine assembled packets
whatDidNotMove.routes: identical — the same nine approved route ids
whatDidNotMove.components: identical — same components, same roles, same order
whatDidNotMove.fixtures: identical — no fixture added, removed or edited
whatDidNotMove.legalDesign: identical — legal-design specifications, templates, registry and controlling authority untouched

boundary.appliesOnlyWhen: the regenerated artifact is byte-identical to the adopted one once sha256, assembledSha256, assembledBytes and byteSize are removed
boundary.recheckedBy: scripts/lib/rcap-counsel-adoption.mjs — the comparison is recomputed from the two artifacts on every run rather than read from this record
doesNotApplyTo: any change to a template, specification or implementation module

runtimeEffect.technicalAndVisualReviewUnaffected: Technical review is a separate gate and reopens on the new bytes by itself.
